query:

Then the teacher said four things: 1. The right hand is definitely not fruit candy. 2. Or the left hand is fruit candies, or fruit candies on the right hand. 3. If the left hand is fruit candies, then the right hand is not fruit candies. 4. Both the left hand and the right hand are fruit candies.

Assuming that three of the four sentences the teacher said are true and one is false, the correct option is 'Left hand fruit candy, right hand toffee'.
predicted_answer: Left hand fruit candy, right hand toffee
